Likelihood profiles of times to reach a level of the asymptote

Source: R/profile.R
profile.timetoTMB.Rd

Profiles the (marginal) log-likelihood for the times estimated by timeto. At each value of a time, the model is reparameterised: the time, e.g. b2 + b3 log(q/(1 - q)) for the logistic model, can be solved for b2, so one coefficient of b2 is computed from the time and the other coefficients, which are re-optimised. For truncated curves, the time also depends on b2 through the threshold b4, and b2 is found numerically.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'timetoTMB'
profile(
  fitted,
  parm = NULL,
  level = 0.99,
  maxit = 100,
  progress = interactive(),
  ...
)

Arguments

fitted

A timetoTMB object, the result of timeto.

parm

Character or integer vector, or NULL. Times to profile, names or positions in coef(fitted); NULL (default) for all of them

level

Numeric between 0 and 1. The highest confidence level the profiles are computed for.

maxit

Integer. Maximum number of steps in each direction

progress

Logical. Show a progress bar over the profiled times

...

Not used.

Value

a profile.timetoTMB object, which has the confint and plot methods of profile.gcTMB

Details

The profiles are for the times of the population curves, without the random effects; the variation between groups (random=TRUE in timeto) and the residual variation are not included. Gaussian models without random effects use the F-based cutoff of profile.gcTMB by default.

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(Height ~ DAS, data=FabaHeights25)
pr <- profile(timeto(fit, level=c(10, 90)), progress=FALSE)
confint(pr)
#>        2.5 %   97.5 %
#> 10% 10.02723 11.69743
#> 90% 55.61865 66.81623
plot(pr)
